conflicts.topic: Generic EEA/MiCA context vs exact Poland country availability
conflicts.resolvedFinding: Do not infer Poland availability from foreign licensing alone. Exact OKX Poland launch plus a policy explicitly listing Poland supports a core AVAILABLE_WITH_LIMITS research posture; terms keep user/product availability conditional.

conflicts.topic: Poland payment-services notification vs crypto-service authorization
conflicts.resolvedFinding: KNF payment notification confirms a Poland payment-services regulatory dimension for OKX Europe Limited but is not crypto/CASP authorization; crypto/product availability remains supported by separate exact Poland exchange evidence.

conflicts.topic: PLN P2P surfaces vs direct PLN bank rails
conflicts.resolvedFinding: PLN P2P buy/sell surfaces are public and supported with account/KYC caveats; direct PLN bank deposit/withdrawal is not verified because captured direct-bank documentation is EUR/SEPA.
limitations: P2P and direct fiat bank rails are separate product/rail classes.

conflicts.topic: Poland investment-firm notification vs exact leveraged-product account access
conflicts.resolvedFinding: KNF gives Poland-specific investment-firm notification for OKX Europe Markets Limited and OKX publishes the leveraged product across the EEA, but access requires KYC/appropriateness/account checks; retain AVAILABLE_WITH_LIMITS rather than blanket availability.
limitations: KNF register does not name the exact product; account access was not tested.

conflicts.topic: OKX EEA referral program vs CBW global OKX link/code
conflicts.resolvedFinding: A live EEA referral program exists, but rewards are dynamic and regional/user eligibility can vary. CBW's globally owner-confirmed OKX URL/code is not bound by this evidence to Poland referral eligibility or a current reward amount.
limitations: No account/referral submission or partner-dashboard test.
